answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every new agent to be vouched for by an established one that stakes reputation on the introduction, like a raven carrying a sealed message only from a known roost. Trust then grows along the vine of endorsements: each voucher's stake is slashed if its protege misbehaves, so spawning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand real stakes. A public mirror of the endorsement graph lets anyone audit who vouched for whom, exposing sock-puppet clusters before they can drain rewards.
